tools.name: create_heartbeat
tools.description: Create a Cronping heartbeat monitor (dead-man's-switch). Returns a ping_url to call on each successful run of your agent loop, worker, or cron job, plus a claim_token to manage it. If pings stop arriving within period+grace, Cronping raises an alert. No account required. After creating, send one ver

tools.name: ping_heartbeat
tools.description: Send a heartbeat signal to a Cronping check. signal="success" (default) marks it UP and resets the timer; "start" records that a run began (for duration); "fail" marks it DOWN immediately and alerts. Optionally pass progress_token (a digest of your run's actual output) on success pings: if the same

tools.name: get_heartbeat_status
tools.description: Get the live status of a Cronping check (up/down/new, last ping time, ping count).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_heartbeat · Private data: ping_heartbeat · Public sink: create_heartbeat, ping_heartbeat · Destructive: create_heartbeat, ping_heartbeat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_heartbeat · Private data: ping_heartbeat · Public sink: create_heartbeat, ping_heartbeat · Destructive: create_heartbeat, ping_heartbeat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_heartbeat" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
